description:
Removal regressions and TUI smoke for the published cutover.

## Assert

- no production import of beadwork tmux.ts
- no beadwork_delegate/worker_done/land_worker/worker_check registrations
- no runBoundedEpicLoop
- no path intent rejects writes
- no duplicate model-visible lifecycle messages from beadwork for minion children
- no permit/bind/report-result/shouldStopAfterTurn orchestration symbols
- `/bw run` rejects --workers
- manual TUI smoke documented: parent interactive, one packet after several idle settlements

Also `npm run build`.

## Files

- tests in both packages
- short smoke checklist in beadwork docs

## Success criteria

- CI catches resurrection of tmux worker path.
- Quality gates: lint, test, typecheck, build.


## Test plan (expanded)

- CI grep/import tests for the full kill list (tools + tmux + runBoundedEpicLoop + permits/report-result/shouldStopAfterTurn).
- `/bw run --workers` rejects.
- Document TUI smoke: parent interactive, one packet after several idle settlements, no tmux.
- npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build.
- Logging: each grep probe result.
